subproject.description: The subproject to log working time against.

dates.description: The dates to create time entries for, each in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-05-21").

hours.description: The number of hours to log for each date (e.g. 8 for a full working day).

comment.description: Optional comment applied to every created time entry.

continueOnError.description: If enabled, a failure on one date will not stop creation for the remaining dates.

aiMetadata.description: Logs the same number of hours on each of several dates in Beebole, in one of two modes: working time against a chosen subproject, or an absence of a chosen type (e.g. vacation, sick leave). Use to bulk-log time across a date range; per-date failures are collected rather than aborting unless continue-on-error is disabled. Not idempotent: each call appends new time entries, so repeating it duplicates them.

delete_multiple_time_entries.name: delete_multiple_time_entries
delete_multiple_time_entries.description: Deletes multiple time entries (working time or absence) by their IDs and dates.

entries.description: List of time entries to delete. Each row requires the time entry ID and the date it was logged on (YYYY-MM-DD).

id.description: The numeric ID of the time entry to delete. You can get this from a "List Time Entries" step or the Beebole API response when the entry was created.

date.description: The date the entry was logged, in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-05-21").

continueOnError.description: If enabled, a failure on one entry will not stop deletion for the remaining entries.

aiMetadata.description: Deletes a batch of time entries in Beebole, each identified by its numeric time-entry ID plus the date it was logged on. Use to remove previously created entries; per-entry failures are collected rather than aborting unless continue-on-error is disabled. Idempotent in effect: once an entry is deleted, re-running with the same IDs has no further effect (already-removed entries simply fail).

nl.Marks a subproject as inactive in Beebol: Markeert een subproject als inactief in Beebole. Inactieve subprojecten worden verborgen voor nieuwe tijden.
nl.Creates time entries (working time or ab: Maakt tijdregistraties (werktijd of afwezigheid) aan over meerdere dagen in Beebole.
nl.Deletes multiple time entries (working t: Verwijdert meerdere tijdregistraties (werktijd of afwezigheid) door hun IDs en data.

nl.Email address. Required if you want to i: E-mail adres. Vereist als u de persoon wilt uitnodigen om in te loggen op Beebole.
nl.Send an invitation email so the person c: Stuur een uitnodigingsmail om in te loggen op Beebole. Vereist een e-mailadres.
nl.The permission level for this person. \": Het permissieniveau voor deze persoon. "Werknemer" kan tijd loggen; "Projectleider" kan ook projecten beheren; "Beheerders" heeft volledige toegang.
nl.The name of the company (customer) to cr: De naam van het bedrijf (klant) om te maken.
nl.Enable if this company represents your o: Inschakelen als dit bedrijf uw eigen organisatie vertegenwoordigt (internal/corporate) in plaats van een klant.
nl.The company (customer) that owns this pr: Het bedrijf (klant) dat eigenaar is van dit project.
nl.The name of the new project (e.g. \"Webs: De naam van het nieuwe project (bijv. "Website Herontwerp").
nl.The project start date in YYYY-MM-DD for: De startdatum van het project in YYYY-MM-DD formaat (bijv. "2026-01-15"). Laat leeg voor geen begindatum.

nl.The project that will contain this subpr: Het project dat deze subproject zal bevatten.

Het bedrijf dat het project bezit.
nl.The project containing the subproject to: Het project met het te deactiveren subproject.
nl.Choose whether you are logging working t: Kies of u de werktijd logt op een subproject of afwezigheid (bijvoorbeeld vakanties, zieke verlies).
nl.The absence type (e.g. Vacation, Sick Le: De afwezigheid type (bijv. Vacation, Sick Leave) om te loggen op de geselecteerde data.
nl.The subproject to log working time again: Het subproject om de werktijd tegen te loggen.
nl.The dates to create time entries for, ea: De datum voor het aanmaken van een tijd invoer, elk in JJJJ-MM-DD formaat (bijv. "2026-05-21").
nl.The number of hours to log for each date: Het aantal te loggen uren voor elke datum (bv. 8 voor een volledige werkdag).
nl.Optional comment applied to every create: Optioneel commentaar toegepast op elke aangemaakte tijdregistratie.
nl.If enabled, a failure on one date will n: Indien ingeschakeld, zal een mislukking op één datum niet stoppen met het maken van de resterende datums.

de.Deletes multiple time entries (working t: Löscht mehrere Zeiteinträge (Arbeitszeit oder Abwesenheit) nach IDs und Datum.

de.The name of the new project (e.g. \"Webs: Der Name des neuen Projekts (z.B. "Website Redesign").

Das Unternehmen, das das Projekt besitzt.
de.The project containing the subproject to: Das Projekt, das das zu deaktivierende Unterprojekt enthält.
de.Choose whether you are logging working t: Wählen Sie, ob Sie die Arbeitszeit auf einem Teilprojekt oder Abwesenheit (z.B. Urlaub, Krankheitsausflug) protokollieren.
de.The absence type (e.g. Vacation, Sick Le: Der Abwesenheitstyp (z.B. Urlaub, Sick Leave), um sich an den ausgewählten Daten anzumelden.

es.The name of the new project (e.g. \"Webs: El nombre del nuevo proyecto (por ejemplo, "Rediseñar Sitio Web").
es.The project start date in YYYY-MM-DD for: La fecha de inicio del proyecto en formato AAA-MM-DD (por ejemplo, "2026-01-15"). Deje en blanco para no tener fecha de inicio.
es.The company that owns the parent project: La empresa propietaria del proyecto matriz.
es.The project that will contain this subpr: El proyecto que contendrá este subproyecto.
es.The name of the new subproject (e.g. \"P: El nombre del nuevo subproyecto (por ejemplo, "Prototipo", "Fase 1").
es.The project containing the subproject to: El proyecto que contiene el subproyecto a desactivar.
es.Choose whether you are logging working t: Elija si está registrando tiempo de trabajo en un subproyecto o una ausencia (por ejemplo, vacaciones, baja por enfermedad).
es.The absence type (e.g. Vacation, Sick Le: El tipo de ausencia (por ejemplo, vacío, baja por enfermedad) para iniciar sesión en las fechas seleccionadas.
El proyecto que contiene el subproyecto.
es.The subproject to log working time again: El subproyecto para registrar el tiempo de trabajo en su lugar.
es.The dates to create time entries for, ea: Las fechas para crear entradas de hora para cada una de ellas en formato AAA-MM-DD (por ejemplo, "2026-05-21").
es.The number of hours to log for each date: El número de horas de registro para cada fecha (por ejemplo, 8 por un día laborable completo).
es.Optional comment applied to every create: Comentario opcional aplicado a cada entrada de hora creada.
es.If enabled, a failure on one date will n: Si se activa, un fallo en una fecha no detendrá la creación para las fechas restantes.
es.List of time entries to delete. Each row: Lista de entradas de tiempo para eliminar. Cada fila requiere el ID de entrada de hora y la fecha en la que se conectó (AAAA-MM-DD).
es.If enabled, a failure on one entry will: Si se activa, un fallo en una entrada no parará la eliminación para las entradas restantes.
es.Authorization headers are injected autom: Las cabeceras de autorización se inyectan automáticamente desde tu conexión.

ja.Time tracking and project management. Cr: 時間追跡とプロジェクト管理。会社、プロジェクト、人、およびログのタイムエントリを作成します。
ja.To get your Beebole API token:\n\n1. Log:
To get your Beebole API token:

1. Log in to your Beebole account at https://beebole-apps.com
2. Go to **Customize → API Token**
3. Generate a new API token 
4. Copy the token and paste it below

Need help? See https://beebole.com/help/api
ja.Create Subproject: サブプロジェクトを作成
ja.Deactivate Subproject: サブプロジェクトを無効にする
ja.Create Multiple Time Entries: 複数の時間エントリーを作成
ja.Delete Multiple Time Entries: 複数の時間エントリを削除
ja.Creates a new person in Beebole. An avai: Beeboleで新しい人を作成します。有効にするには使用可能なライセンスが必要です。
ja.Creates a new company (customer) in Beeb: Beeboleに新しい会社（顧客）を作成します。
ja.Creates a new project under a company in: Beeboleの会社の下に新しいプロジェクトを作成します。
ja.Creates a new subproject under an existi: Beebole の既存のプロジェクトの下に新しいサブプロジェクトを作成します。
ja.Marks a subproject as inactive in Beebol: Beeboleではサブプロジェクトを非アクティブとしてマークします。非アクティブなサブプロジェクトは新しい時間のエントリから非表示になります。
ja.Creates time entries (working time or ab: Beeboleで複数日のタイムエントリ(作業時間または不在)を作成します。
ja.Deletes multiple time entries (working t: IDと日付で複数のタイムエントリ(作業時間または不在)を削除します。
ja.Make a custom API call to a specific end: 特定のエンドポイントへのカスタム API コールを実行します。
ja.Response is Binary ?: 応答はバイナリですか?
ja.No Error on Failure: 失敗時にエラーはありません
ja.Follow redirects: リダイレクトをフォローする
ja.The full name of the person (e.g. \"Jane: 人物の完全な名前(例:"ジェーンDoe")。
ja.Email address. Required if you want to i: メールアドレスです。Beeboleにログインする人を招待する場合に必要です。
ja.Send an invitation email so the person c: 招待メールを送信して、その人がビーボーにログインできるようにします。メールアドレスが必要です。
ja.The permission level for this person. \": この人物の権限レベル。「従業員」は時間を記録できます。「プロジェクトリード」はプロジェクトを管理することもできます。「管理者」はフルアクセス権を持っています。
ja.The name of the company (customer) to cr: 作成する会社(顧客)の名前。
ja.Enable if this company represents your o: この会社が顧客ではなく、自分の組織（内部/企業）を表す場合に有効にします。
ja.The company (customer) that owns this pr: このプロジェクトを所有する会社（顧客）。
ja.The name of the new project (e.g. \"Webs: 新規プロジェクトの名前 (例: 「ウェブサイトの再設定」)。
ja.The project start date in YYYY-MM-DD for: プロジェクトの開始日はYYYY-MM-DD形式（例："2026-01-15"）です。開始日を指定しない場合は空白のままにします。
プロジェクトの任意の説明。
ja.The company that owns the parent project: 親プロジェクトを所有する会社。
ja.The project that will contain this subpr: このサブプロジェクトを含むプロジェクト。
ja.The name of the new subproject (e.g. \"P: 新規サブプロジェクトの名前 (例: "プロトタイプ"、"フェーズ1")。
プロジェクトを所有している会社。
ja.The project containing the subproject to: 無効にするサブプロジェクトを含むプロジェクト。
無効にするサブプロジェクト。
ja.Choose whether you are logging working t: サブプロジェクトで作業時間を記録しているか、不在か (休暇、休暇など) を選択します。
ja.The absence type (e.g. Vacation, Sick Le: 選択した日付にログインする不在のタイプ (例: 休暇、病気休暇)。
サブプロジェクトを含むプロジェクト。
ja.The subproject to log working time again: 作業時間を記録するサブプロジェクト。
ja.The dates to create time entries for, ea: YYYY-MM-DD形式(例:"2026-05-21")でタイムエントリを作成する日付。
ja.The number of hours to log for each date: 日付ごとにログに記録する時間数(例:1日あたり8時間)。
ja.Optional comment applied to every create: 作成されたすべての時間エントリに適用される任意のコメント。
ja.If enabled, a failure on one date will n: 有効にすると、残りの日付の作成が停止しません。
ja.List of time entries to delete. Each row: 削除するタイムエントリのリスト。各行には、タイムエントリIDとログオンした日付(YYYY-MM-DD)が必要です。
ja.If enabled, a failure on one entry will: 有効にすると、1つのエントリの失敗は残りのエントリの削除を停止しません。
ja.Authorization headers are injected autom: 認証ヘッダは接続から自動的に注入されます。
PDF、画像などのファイルを有効にする

zh.Creates a new person in Beebole. An avai: Creates a new person in Beebole. An available license is required for the person to be active.
zh.Creates a new company (customer) in Beeb: Creates a new company (customer) in Beebole.

The company this person belongs to.

zh.Send an invitation email so the person c: Send an invitation email so the person can log in to Beebole. Requires an email address.
zh.The permission level for this person. \": The permission level for this person. "Employee" can log time; "Project Lead" can also manage projects; "Admin" has full access.

zh.Enable if this company represents your o: Enable if this company represents your own organization (internal/corporate) rather than a customer.

zh.The project that will contain this subpr: The project that will contain this subproject.
zh.The name of the new subproject (e.g. \"P: The name of the new subproject (e.g. "Prototype", "Phase 1").
The company that owns the project.
zh.The project containing the subproject to: The project containing the subproject to deactivate.
zh.Choose whether you are logging working t: Choose whether you are logging working time on a subproject or an absence (e.g. vacation, sick leave).
zh.The absence type (e.g. Vacation, Sick Le: The absence type (e.g. Vacation, Sick Leave) to log on the selected dates.
zh.The subproject to log working time again: The subproject to log working time against.
zh.The dates to create time entries for, ea: The dates to create time entries for, each in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-05-21").

zh.If enabled, a failure on one entry will: If enabled, a failure on one entry will not stop deletion for the remaining entries.

pt.Time tracking and project management. Cr: Controle de tempo e gerenciamento de projetos. Crie empresas, projetos, pessoas e registre entradas de tempo.
pt.To get your Beebole API token:\n\n1. Log:
Para obter o seu token de API Beebole:

1. Faça o login em sua conta Beebole em https://beebole-apps. om
2. Vá para **Personalize → API Token**
3. Gerar um novo token de API 
4. Copie o token e cole abaixo

Precisa de ajuda? Veja https://beebole.com/help/api
pt.Creates a new person in Beebole. An avai: Cria uma nova pessoa no Beebole. É necessária uma licença disponível para a pessoa estar ativa.
pt.Creates a new company (customer) in Beeb: Cria uma nova empresa (cliente) no Beebole.
pt.Creates a new project under a company in: Cria um novo projeto sob uma empresa no Beebole.
pt.Creates a new subproject under an existi: Cria um novo subprojeto sob um projeto existente no Beebole.
pt.Marks a subproject as inactive in Beebol: Marca um subprojeto como inativo no Beebole. Subprojetos inativos são ocultados de novas entradas de tempo.
pt.Creates time entries (working time or ab: Cria entradas de tempo (tempo de trabalho ou ausência) durante vários dias em Beebole.
pt.Deletes multiple time entries (working t: Exclui várias entradas de tempo (tempo de trabalho ou ausência) por suas identificações e datas.
pt.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Faça uma chamada de API personalizada para um ponto de extremidade específico
A empresa a qual essa pessoa pertence.
pt.The full name of the person (e.g. \"Jane: O nome completo da pessoa (ex: "Jane Doe").
pt.Email address. Required if you want to i: Endereço de e-mail. Obrigatório se quiser convidar a pessoa a fazer login no Beebole.
pt.Send an invitation email so the person c: Envie um e-mail de convite para que a pessoa possa fazer login no Beebole. Requer um endereço de e-mail.
pt.The permission level for this person. \": O nível de permissão para esta pessoa. "Empregado" pode registrar o tempo; "Líder do Projeto" também pode gerenciar projetos; "Admin" tem acesso total.
pt.The name of the company (customer) to cr: O nome da empresa (cliente) para criar.
pt.Enable if this company represents your o: Ativar se esta empresa representa sua própria organização (internamente / corporativo) ao invés de um cliente.
pt.The name of the new project (e.g. \"Webs: O nome do novo projeto (por exemplo, "Website Redesign").
pt.The project start date in YYYY-MM-DD for: A data de início do projeto em formato YYYY-MM-DD (por exemplo, "2026-01-15"). Deixe em branco para nenhuma data de início.
pt.The company that owns the parent project: A empresa proprietária do projeto pai.
pt.The project that will contain this subpr: O projeto que conterá este subprojeto.
pt.The name of the new subproject (e.g. \"P: O nome do novo subprojeto (por exemplo, "Protótipo", "Fase 1").
pt.The project containing the subproject to: O projeto que contém o subprojeto a ser desativado.
pt.Choose whether you are logging working t: Escolha se você está registrando o tempo de trabalho em um subprojeto ou em uma ausência (por exemplo, férias, licença de doença).
pt.The absence type (e.g. Vacation, Sick Le: Tipo de ausência (por exemplo, Vaca, Folha Doente) para registrar as datas selecionadas.
O projeto que contém o subprojeto.
pt.The subproject to log working time again: O subprojeto para registrar o tempo de trabalho.
pt.The dates to create time entries for, ea: As datas para criar entradas de tempo, cada um no formato YYYY-MM-DD (ex. "2026-05-21").
pt.The number of hours to log for each date: O número de horas de registo para cada data (ex.: 8 para um dia de trabalho completo).
pt.Optional comment applied to every create: Comentário opcional aplicado a cada entrada de tempo criada.
pt.If enabled, a failure on one date will n: Se ativado, uma falha em uma data não irá parar a criação para as datas restantes.
pt.List of time entries to delete. Each row: Lista de entradas de tempo para excluir. Cada linha requer o ID da entrada de horário e a data em que foi logado (AAAA-MM-DD).
pt.If enabled, a failure on one entry will: Se ativado, uma falha em uma entrada não irá parar a exclusão das entradas restantes.
pt.Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
Habilitar para arquivos como PDFs, imagens, etc.
